_about: Zones where every subdomain is a separate customer's name, kept as shared suffixes whatever the zone's own popularity. Read by scripts/build_public_suffixes_in_top.py only (scripts/build_top_domains.py calls it), which adds them to data/public_suffixes_in_top.json; every reader of that file sees them: the scorer (instant-safe refusal, _check_brand_on_hosting_tenant), the ML model's tenant features (versioned: model_meta.json feature_data, docs/THIRD_PARTY_FEEDS.md 'Sequencing'), the blocklist publisher's tenant guard, confirmed_threats.site_name, the extension's hostingTenantSuffixes and the phone's shared_suffixes.txt. Not data/hosting_platforms.json: its tenant_suffixes reach the served model at once, without the feature-data pairing.

psl_operators._about: Registrable names (last two labels) whose Public Suffix List PRIVATE-section rules are all kept, rules the operator adds later included; ICANN-section rules are never taken from here. Until 2026-10-23 the file held them because Tranco's top 100k ranked these names (DNS traffic to the tenants counted for the zone). The licensed ranking drops tenant rows before it ranks a name (build_top_domains.fold), so a tenant zone's own name rarely ranks, and #284 lost these 235 names' 468 rules: trycloudflare.com, cloud.goog, jcloud.kz, playstation-cloud.com, ngrok.io, on.aws, us.kg, replit.dev, dynamic-DNS zones and more. The list is that diff: 5a3c0ffa^:data/public_suffixes_in_top.json minus the rebuilt file, private-section rules of the 2026-10-23 PSL only.

not_in_psl._about: Tenant zones the Public Suffix List does not carry, one by one, each with dated evidence that any name under it is a customer's: wildcard DNS, the operator's wildcard certificate, and the service's answer for an unknown name.
not_in_psl.s3.cloud.ru: Verified 2026-10-23: Cloud.ru Object Storage, bucket by host name (<bucket>.s3.cloud.ru). Any label resolves (wildcard A 176.109.98.30/31) and an unknown one answers 404 NoSuchBucket; certificate CN=s3.cloud.ru, SAN s3.cloud.ru + *.s3.cloud.ru, O=CLOUD TECHNOLOGIES LLC (GlobalSign OV, to 2026-12-20)
not_in_psl.s3-website.cloud.ru: Verified 2026-10-23: Cloud.ru Object Storage static websites (<bucket>.s3-website.cloud.ru). The same wildcard A 176.109.98.30/31 and 404 NoSuchBucket for an unknown label; certificate CN=*.s3-website.cloud.ru, O=Cloud.ru LLC (GlobalSign GCC OV, to 2027-02-19)
not_in_psl.s3-alt.cloud.ru: Verified 2026-10-23: Cloud.ru Object Storage alternative endpoint (<bucket>.s3-alt.cloud.ru). Wildcard A 94.158.22.17 and 404 NoSuchBucket for an unknown label; certificate CN=s3-alt.cloud.ru, SAN *.s3-alt.cloud.ru, O=Cloud.ru LLC (GlobalSign OV, to 2027-03-02)
